text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "...I've been watching Umatuber-chan's 24-hour livestream since last night... Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"She's fallen fast asleep, though...
Her sleeping face is a literal angel... I could gaze at it forever."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, shoot!
I can't afford... to miss this precious footage...!"

Having watched livestreams all night long,
Agnes Digital was relentlessly assailed by drowsiness...
